briefdescription.para: Wave 3-D network module gap-fix safety tests.

detaileddescription.para: Validates the five critical/high fixes shipped in Wave 3-D: W3D-01 QosManager rejects interface names containing shell metacharacters. W3D-02 QosManager accepts well-formed interface names. W3D-03 RaftLoadBalancer defaultHealthCheck returns false for a dead port. W3D-04 RaftLoadBalancer defaultHealthCheck returns true for a live port. W3D-05 WireProtocolServer lock-ordering contract is documented in source.
